title: JAPAN MATE 메인 홈페이지 UI
content: Create a high-fidelity desktop website UI for 'JAPAN MATE', a Japanese package travel guide service targeting Korean users in their 20s and 30s. Use a clean, modern travel platform style. Create the main homepage screen with a hero banner, search area, featured package tours, popular destinations and a footer.

title: JAPAN MATE 패키지 검색 결과 UI
content: Create a high-fidelity package travel listing screen for 'JAPAN MATE'. Include filter controls, sorting options, multiple package cards, prices, duration, destination labels, ratings and pagination. Make the products easy to search and compare.

title: 봄의 오사카성 여행 사진
content: Create a geographically plausible commercial travel photograph of Osaka Castle in spring. Frame the castle with mature cherry blossoms under natural blue sky and soft morning daylight. Use a wide 16:9 landscape crop with no text, logo or watermark.

title: 블로그 글 작성 도우미
content: 당신은 전문 블로거입니다. 여행 주제로 서론, 본론, 결론 구조의 글을 작성해주세요.
